protocol.metric: Actual output tokens divided by total synchronized engine.generate wall time of 64 requests x 4 seeds, including prefill and output decoding. Each matched case uses the same seed, input groups, physical GPU, CPU affinity and per-run fresh scheduler. No HTTP, startup or profiling hooks in timed runs.
protocol.arms: Fixed sends all feasible drafts up to 4. Post generates that full window then trims. Both measured again from the frozen checkout before editing. Early makes admissions in gen() at every depth, compacts active requests and never runs a stopped request in a later draft-model step. CUDA Graphs use the existing buckets; padding has no live KV slot.
protocol.confidence: Both dynamic modes use max of the current temperature-adjusted draft distribution, cumulative products and the same linear target-cost gate. Post visits prefixes in global heap order; early ranks the candidates visible at the current depth and makes irreversible admissions.
protocol.calibration: Both dynamic policies use exactly the last benchmark's target calibration for the same model and physical GPU. Fresh startup measurements are also recorded for each engine. No tailoring to prompts or trial outputs.
protocol.warmup: 32 disjoint prompts; prewarm each engine at batch sizes 1,8,32, using up to 40 new tokens. Any trial with a new target CUDA Graph or a new compiled graph is excluded and repeated.
protocol.diagnostics: Independent 64-prompt instrumented run per target/batch: 8B seed 4701 GPU 0; 32B seed 4702 GPU 2. The generated count is the number of proposals kept for verification. The distribution for the stopping position may already have been computed and sampled; scored_candidate_distributions includes it. Actual request rows checked before every draft graph replay using position, remaining budget and request offset. Uncut physical rows are computed with the original graph bucketing on those same starting requests and per-round budgets. They are a per-round counterfactual, not timed measurements of the fixed or post arm.

diagnostics.reference: Same input requests and per-round starting state, with every budget used to its limit.
